title.en: Chain rule, maximum likelihood, and forward KL
title.zh: 链式法则、最大似然估计与前向KL散度

en.a: Separate the probability model from the architecture that computes each conditional.
en.b: Establish why autoregressive maximum likelihood is equivalent to minimizing forward KL and how sequence NLL becomes perplexity.

zh.a: 将概率模型与计算每个条件概率的架构分离。
zh.b: 阐明自回归最大似然估计为何等价于最小化前向KL散度，以及序列负对数似然如何转化为困惑度。
